verdict.rationale: The axis applies: an AI work assistant could plausibly let users run one action across many items. The pack never documents a user-directed bulk operation feature. Automatic inbox triage with labels and drafts for every email needing a response [lindy-docs-32] is a per-email background feature, not a bulk-operations capability. Routines [lindy-docs-19] cover recurring schedules, not one action applied across many items at once.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can perform bulk operations across many items at once
